items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: I left them playing together when I left him. That's the guy who played the bass, T-Boy.

ctx.x: But who's T-Boy? T-Boy played bass.

And who is he? He died in Eddie Gilmore. That's Eddie Gilmore. He's a good bass player. I left them playing together when I left him. That's the guy who played the bass, T-Boy. And you were playing mandolin? Yeah.
Well did y'all stay in one place or did you serenade?
